epistemic_note_lv: PROPOSED mācību politika. Instances nāk no N20 bankas; atbildes ir skolēna rakstībā (decimālkoma, mērvienības nav atkārtotas, jo tās nāk no instances). Punktu summas ir aprēķinātas ar roku no deklarētās rubrikas un sasaldētā pilna-vai-nulles noteikuma; tās nav oficiālas eksāmena atzīmes.
computation_note: Per slot: auto = sum of awarded criterion points, pending = sum of pending-external criterion points, denied = auto_max − auto (graded slots only), zeroed = auto_max + pending_max (unattempted/incomplete/invalid slots, whose points are neither awarded, denied nor pending). Every form satisfies auto + pending_external + denied + zeroed = 100 and auto_max + pending_max = 100.

forms.notes: Every slot carries an answer; every machine criterion is denied with its engine verdict recorded. Wrong numerics keep the declared dimension and unit and sit far outside the tolerance, wrong selections use declared distractor ids, the ordering is reversed, the pairs are permuted. Self-assessed and manual criteria stay pending-external — a wrong free text is never scored.

forms.notes: The honesty matrix. Malformed trio: (1) S4-1 is a mixed-separator numeric "1.000,50" caught by the engine as UNREADABLE_INPUT (slot stays graded, zero, raw preserved); (2) S3-2 is a truncated ordering list caught by the completion gate as incomplete; (3) S1-2 is a Q13 vector with an empty coefficient cell, also incomplete. A fourth structural case: S2-3 is a stored Q12 payload whose read.x is a number (a shape the component cannot produce but a stored/imported session can), caught by the completion gate as invalid. S3-1 is a Q02 with a blank substep (incomplete); S4-3 and S6-3 are unattempted; S6-2 (Q05) and S7-1 (Q03) are manual pending; S5-1 is a Q15 self-assessment text; S2-1/S2-2/S6-1 are option_select with justification (auto selection plus pending justification).
